notes:
Dahu 0.101.2 beta for Windows.

- Reorganised Select, Organize and View menus, with floating managers for groups, blocks and saved views.
- Join reports input counts and open or closed curves and polysurfaces.
- Fit prioritises the selection; explicit active-view and all-view actions remain available.
- Edit group names in Properties. Overlapping picks show the group and highlight all its members.
- More reliable picking near the camera's clipping limits.
- Preferences > Navigation has a compact Device gestures guide, with aligned Device and Gestures controls.
- Better toolbar layout on narrow Windows views, preserving full display-mode labels.
